ops.name: order
ops.note: Fetches full order record by GID including revenue, currency, customer identity, line items, and created timestamp when the webhook payload is insufficient

webhooks.note: Fires when a new order is created in Shopify, delivering the order payload that seeds the local order and line-item records

Fires only on cancellation rather than every order mutation (orders/updated would deliver noise on every edit). Payload includes cancelled_at and the final order state needed to transition the local row to cancelled and recalculate the affected daily snapshot.

webhooks.trigger_event: a refund is created for an order (full or partial)
webhooks.note: Fires for each refund creation and includes the refund amount and parent order, which the orders/updated topic does not directly expose. The handler aggregates cumulative refunds per order: if cumulative equals gross revenue the order transitions to refunded, otherwise revenue is reduced and the order stays completed.
